# Dr. Javad Rezazadeh Yazdeli

> Official bilingual public website of Dr. Javad Rezazadeh Yazdeli, covering verified academic work, education, student guidance, Golden Talent, books, publishing, and public scholarly activity.

Use only public URLs listed here or discoverable through the canonical sitemap. Persian and English are separate audience editions rather than mirrored translations. Private account, assessment, consultation-intake, checkout, and dashboard routes are intentionally excluded. Public Golden Talent pages describe a developmental, multi-source evidence framework and must not be interpreted as validated normative scoring, gifted cut-offs, or deterministic career prescription.

## Persian Knowledge Hub — 45 evergreen guides

- [Knowledge Hub](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/): Canonical index of 45 Persian evergreen guides grouped into four topical clusters.
- [Golden Talent overview](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/golden-talent-chist/): Multi-source, developmental interpretation of talent and next-step planning.
- [How to identify a child's talent](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/chegoone-estedaad-vaghei-farzand-ra-beshenasim/): Evidence from performance, interest, opportunity, observation and development.
- [Why one talent test is not enough](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/chera-yek-test-baraye-estedaadyabi-kafi-nist/): Limits of single-test interpretation.
- [Talent, interest and labour market](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/estedaad-alaghe-bazaar-kar/): Multi-criteria educational decision-making.
- [Comprehensive university major choice](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/entekhab-reshteh-jame/): Preference ordering, fit, constraints and option comparison.
- [Educational consultation](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/moshavere-tahsili-takhasosi-chist/): When individualised consultation adds value.
- [Diagnostic manuscript review](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/chera-maghale-amade-ersal-nist/): Argument, method, reporting and journal-readiness.
- [Journal selection](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/entekhab-majale-monaseb/): Scope, audience, trustworthiness and submission strategy.
- [Response to reviewers](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/pasokh-be-davaran/): Evidence-based and traceable revision responses.
- [Academic CV](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/academic-cv-professional/): Verifiable evidence and opportunity-specific academic presentation.
- [Good assessment design](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/azmoon-khoob-vijegiha/): Validity, reliability, fairness and score interpretation.
- [AI in teaching](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/ai-dar-tadris/): Human-centred use, privacy, risk and teacher judgement.
- [Teacher professional development](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/tosee-herfei-moalleman/): Practice, feedback, action planning and review.
- [School talent identification system](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/madarese-system-estedaadyabi/): Multi-source identification connected to opportunity and review.

## Question-first student and family entry points (public, free-to-read)

These are routes for readers and third-party tools that choose to consult this file. Google Search does **not** use llms.txt as a ranking or AI inclusion signal; standard HTML indexing, helpful content and genuine internal links remain authoritative. The six questions are explained in visible HTML with relevant original educational material. A link to a service is optional, not proof of a booking, payment or assessment validity.

- [شش سؤال دانش‌آموز و خانواده / My Path — Persian](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/masir-man/): Six questions, free guides, genuine educational resources and proportionate optional services.
- [Six student questions — English](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/en/my-path/): Evidence-based explanatory summaries, free learning tools and contextual service descriptions; not six new English research papers.
- [How can I study better? BAHAR FA](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/bahar/): Research-informed retrieval, spaced review and practical study planning, with two free introductory modules.
- [How can I study better? BAHAR EN](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/en/bahar/): English learning guidance with research citations and a free revisable plan.
- [How should I read an academic scorecard?](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/tahlil-karname-tahsili/): Trend, assessment context and limits, without fabricated admission odds.
- [Which degree or university path fits?](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/che-reshteyi-baraye-man-monaseb-ast/): Separate official eligibility, preferences, evidence and constraints.
- [What should a developmental evidence report contain?](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/gozaresh-estedaad-va-masir-roshd/): Uncertainty, learner participation and actionable revisable steps.
- [How can I compare university choices?](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/moghayese-reshteha-ba-matris-tasmim/): Multi-criteria comparisons without a fictional final score.
- [English student guidance](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/en/student-guidance/): University decisions, educational autonomy and evidence-limited advice.

## Evidence-qualified professional services and bookstore

These are public descriptions of proposed advisory scopes, not proof of current booking availability or a guaranteed result. Payment and timing depend on confirmation through the original guarded process. Persian and English pages are genuine audience editions; individual service descriptions retain contextual and methodological limits.

- [English VIP advisory overview](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/en/vip/): Compare six defined advisory scopes.
- [Persian VIP overview](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/vip/): شرایط مشاوره تخصصی و ظرفیت‌پذیری.
- [Research and publication advice](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/en/vip/research-publication/): Manuscript diagnosis, revision priorities and journal fit without an acceptance guarantee.
- [Educator professional development](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/en/vip/educator-development/): Situated teaching issues, evidence-informed reflection and revisable action planning.
- [University selection](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/en/vip/university-selection/): Programme priorities based on verified eligibility, personal goals and constraints, not admission guarantees.
- [Academic direction](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/en/vip/academic-direction/): Provisional educational decision pathways rather than permanent labels.
- [Golden Talent Signature](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/en/vip/golden-talent-signature/): Developmental evidence review; not a psychometrically validated diagnostic tool.
- [Institutional advisory](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/en/vip/institutional-advisory/): Context-dependent management options, not guaranteed organisational outcomes.
- [English bookstore](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/en/shop/): Public descriptions, purchase guidance and educational support.
- [فروشگاه کتاب فارسی](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/shop/): معرفی آثار و راهنمای خرید و حمایت تحصیلی.

## Publishing and journal

- [JHELA international founding journal](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/journal/): English-language scholarly journal; international reviewer and editorial recruitment open, manuscript intake not yet active.
- [JHELA public scholarly dashboard](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/journal/dashboard/): Separate routes for interested peer reviewers, prospective editorial collaborators, authors and readers; no private accounts or formal submission.
- [JHELA aims and scope](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/journal/aims-scope/): Scientific orientation, evidential transparency and contextual interpretation.
- [JHELA publication ethics](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/journal/ethics/): Founding policy on research integrity and editorial independence.
- [JHELA peer-review policy](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/journal/peer-review/): Planned independent double-anonymised research-article review.
- [JHELA author guidelines](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/journal/author-guidelines/): Scholarly expectations prior to submission opening.
